#
# The Arch packages CI installs to configure, build and test every shell
# library and phosphor-libs under it. One package per line. A comment after `#`
# is ignored.
base-devel
git
ccache
cmake
ninja
extra-cmake-modules
qt6-base
qt6-declarative
qt6-shadertools
qt6-svg
qt6-wayland
wayland
wayland-protocols
# phosphor-shell-lock reads the keyboard layout and Caps Lock from the seat's
# keymap; xkeyboard-config gives its test keymaps to compile.
libxkbcommon
xkeyboard-config
# Qt declares QVulkanInstance only when the Vulkan headers are present, and
# phosphor-libs' phosphor-surfaces uses it wherever Qt was built with Vulkan.
vulkan-headers
# KF6: the libraries draw their icons through Kirigami. KGlobalAccel and
# PlasmaActivities are optional lookups in phosphor-libs, installed so CI
# builds what they switch on.
kirigami
kglobalaccel
plasma-activities
# The service libraries' system interfaces: PipeWire (phosphor-service-pipewire),
# polkit-qt6 (phosphor-service-polkit), PAM (phosphor-service-lock) and ddcutil
# (phosphor-service-brightness's optional external-monitor backend).
libpipewire
polkit-qt6
pam
ddcutil
# The offscreen and Wayland tests' runtime.
mesa
# A real font family, so the theme's font tests resolve an installed face
# rather than skipping on fontconfig's aliases.
ttf-dejavu
# The tray tests' fixture (libs/phosphor-shell-bar/tests/tray-fixture.py), a
# set of real StatusNotifierItem apps on the test's private bus.
python-dbus
python-gobject
